title: Wrong player draws: the controller draws 1 instead of the opponent who discarded.
expected: insightful-investigator.ts:34 models the follow-up as `{ amount: 1, type: "draw" }` with no `player` field inside the controller's sequence. effects/draw.ts:33-82 (handle_draw) defaults to `ctx.playerId` (the controller) when `player` is neither "each" nor "target-controller", so player-1 draws instead of the opponent. The draw is also a sibling of the `reveal-hand` pending choice in the sequence (lines 28-36), so it executes immediately on opt-in rather than after the pick/discard, matching the observed timing. Rules text says "they discard that card and draw 1" — the opponent should draw.
observed: In both games player-1's hand grew by 1 (Sinister Poro / Chemtech Enforcer drawn; p1 main deck 35→34) and the draw happened immediately on accepting the opt-in, before any card was picked. Player-2 went 4→3 cards in hand and p2 main deck stayed at 36 (no draw). Card def models the follow-up as a bare {type:'draw',amount:1} in the controller's sequence.

history.note: landed the engine half (handle_draw now honors player:'opponent'); the card-def half (adding player:'opponent' to the draw step) is in a file another lane is actively rewriting, so left to them
